notes: v2 (Phase 3). Amharic narration approved by the author (native speaker), 25 Nov 2026. The grandmother is not named in the film (author's privacy choice). Model ids verified by the Phase 2 smoke test.

project.title: Buna
project.logline: Three small cups, three rounds, and nobody is left out.
project.audience: Young Ethiopians and diaspora family members, watching on a phone in a social feed, mostly vertical.
project.intent: They slow down and feel belonging: the ceremony is not about coffee, it is about time and being together.

style_block: Hand-painted illustration with visible brush texture, warm golden morning light, soft film grain, earthy palette of terracotta, amber, charcoal black and fresh green, gentle depth of field, intimate and calm, a modest Ethiopian home, main subject centred with generous empty margins on every side, no text, no letters, no logos.

references.description: A traditional Ethiopian jebena coffee pot of matte black clay: a perfectly round, spherical body; a long, narrow, upright neck rising from the top of the body; a curved handle joining the neck to the body; and a short spout rising from the shoulder of the body. Not a teapot, no lid, not a vase
Small white porcelain sini cups with NO handles, shaped like tiny round bowls, arranged in rows on a low carved wooden rekebot tray
An elderly Ethiopian woman always seen from behind, never showing her face, wrapped in a white cotton netela shawl with a narrow woven coloured border (tibeb), seated on a low wooden stool

narration_defaults.style: Speak slowly, warmly and gently, like an elder remembering a morning ritual.

shots.reason: Establishing shot: where and when we are, and the slow pace of the morning.

narration.am: ሁልጊዜ ጠዋት፣ ከተማዋ ከመንቃቷ በፊት፣ አያቴ ትኩስ ቄጠማ ትጎዘጉዝ ነበር።
narration.en: Every morning, before the city woke, my grandmother spread fresh grass on the floor.

keyframe.prompt: Wide view of a modest home courtyard at dawn: long blades of fresh-cut green grass scattered loosely across a bare earthen floor (not a lawn, not growing), a low wooden stool and a small charcoal brazier waiting in the centre, soft mist and first golden light through an open doorway

motion.prompt: mist drifts slowly, light brightens; camera pushes in very slowly

shots.reason: The first object of the ritual; sets a patient, tactile rhythm.

narration.am: አረንጓዴውን ቡና ቀስ ብላ ታጥብ ነበር። ቡናን ፈጽሞ አታቻኩልም ነበር።
narration.en: She washed the green beans slowly. She never rushed coffee.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of green unroasted coffee beans being rinsed in water inside a round dark clay bowl, droplets catching soft morning light, fingertips only partly visible at the edge of the frame

motion.prompt: water ripples gently around the beans; camera fixed

shots.reason: Sensory hook of the first round: fire and the smell that gathers people.

narration.am: ከዚያም እሳቱ ይነድ ነበር፤ ጎረቤቶችን የሚጠራው መዓዛም ይሸት ነበር።
narration.en: Then came the fire, and the smell that called the neighbours in.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of coffee beans roasting in a flat round iron pan over glowing charcoal, beans turning from pale green to deep brown, thin curls of smoke rising into warm light

motion.prompt: smoke rises and curls slowly, the beans shift gently in the pan; camera fixed

shots.reason: Mood and welcome without hands or faces; incense is part of the ceremony.

narration.am: የዕጣኑ ጭስ ቤቱን ይሞላ ነበር። "እንኳን ደህና መጣችሁ" የምትልበት መንገዷ ነበር።
narration.en: Incense filled the room. It was her way of saying: welcome.

keyframe.prompt: Fragrant frankincense smoke curling up from a small clay incense burner resting on fresh grass, strongly backlit by golden light against a dark warm background

motion.prompt: incense smoke curls upward slowly; camera fixed

shots.reason: Rhythm of grinding links the picture to the score.

narration.am: የቡና መውቀጥ ድምፅ የቀኔ የመጀመሪያው ሙዚቃ ነበር።
narration.en: The sound of grinding was the first music of my day.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of a traditional wooden mortar filled with dark roasted coffee beans, a metal pestle resting inside it, warm side light, no hands, no people anywhere in the frame

motion.prompt: the pestle moves down slowly into the mortar; camera fixed

shots.reason: A breath in the pacing: waiting is part of the gift.

narration.am: ከዚያም እንጠብቅ ነበር። መጠበቅም የስጦታው አካል እንደሆነ አስተማረችኝ።
narration.en: Then we waited. She taught me that waiting is part of the gift.

keyframe.prompt: A black clay jebena coffee pot resting on glowing charcoal, gentle steam rising from its spout, deep warm shadows, calm and still

motion.prompt: steam rises gently from the spout; camera fixed

shots.reason: Hero shot and recurring motif: one pot pouring into many cups.

narration.am: አንድ ጀበና። ብዙ ሲኒዎች። ማንም ቀርቶ አያውቅም።
narration.en: One pot. Many cups. No one was ever left out.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up inside a warm, dim room with earthen walls and fresh grass on the floor: the black clay jebena is tilted from the upper left, and a thin, unbroken stream of dark coffee flows OUT OF ITS SPOUT down into a small white cup; the cup sits among a row of identical small white cups on a low carved wooden tray; every cup is a tiny round bowl with NO handle; steam rises, warm golden light; the reference images give only the look of the objects; the setting is the room described, never a plain backdrop

motion.prompt: the coffee stream pours steadily into the cups, steam rises; camera fixed

shots.reason: The human presence of the film, shown from behind to avoid any real likeness.

narration.am: ሦስት ዙሮች፤ አቦል፣ ቶና፣ እና በረካ፤ የበረከቱ ዙር።
narration.en: Three rounds: abol, tona, and baraka, the blessing.

keyframe.prompt: Inside a warm, dim room with earthen walls and fresh grass strewn on the floor, a glowing charcoal brazier nearby: an elderly woman seen only from behind, seated on a low wooden stool, holding out a small white cup toward the viewer, soft warm backlight around her shawl, face not visible; the reference images give only the look of the objects; the setting is the room described, never a plain backdrop

motion.prompt: she holds the cup out, slight movement of the shawl; camera fixed

shots.reason: Emotional peak: the blessing round, community implied by waiting seats.

narration.am: በሦስተኛው ሲኒ እንግዶች ቤተሰብ ይሆኑ ነበር።
narration.en: By the third cup, strangers had become family.

keyframe.prompt: Inside a warm, dim room with earthen walls and fresh grass strewn on the floor, in warm late-morning light: a carved wooden tray of small white coffee cups with wisps of steam, a woven basket of roasted popcorn beside it, empty low wooden stools around as if people are about to gather; the reference images give only the look of the objects; the setting is the room described, never a plain backdrop

motion.prompt: steam drifts from the cups; camera fixed

shots.reason: Closing motif that answers shot 1: the door opens, the invitation stays.

narration.am: "ትንሽ ቆዩ" ትል ነበር፤ "ቡናው ገና ትኩስ ነው።"
narration.en: 'Stay a little longer,' she always said. 'The coffee is still warm.'

keyframe.prompt: A wooden door opening from the courtyard onto bright morning light, fresh grass on the floor, the jebena resting by the brazier in the foreground

motion.prompt: the door swings open slowly and light floods in; camera fixed

cues.caption: Ethiopian-inspired acoustic instrumental, plucked krar lyre, soft bowed masenqo, gentle hand percussion entering midway, warm, intimate, unhurried, sparse texture with no strong lead melody, a simple theme that returns at the end
